facts.material: plastic/metal housing with multiple filter media layers

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8421 covers filtering or purifying machinery and apparatus for liquids; chapter 84 note 1 and section XVI note 1 do not exclude
GRI 6: 8421.21 for filtering or purifying water

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts provision; the unit is a complete filter, not a part
not a tap or valve; its function is filtration

classification.rationale: An in-line unit with filtration layers that purifies water is filtering or purifying apparatus for water under 8421.21. N005068 classified a water filter cartridge performing the filtering function in 8421.21.0000 (different construction, same function).
